book.name: Iba
book.title: Iba ngwi a kye tso iJɔn

content: Uga itingga mgbi Imgbasho egyafa
Nɛ ani fwo ela okwukwo kyɛ mi ozu okwukwo osunu Imgbasho le gbɔ yi engyesɔ egyafa ntona gbɛɛ, <<Kɛ ka kye uga itingga mgbi Imgbasho egyafa ntona yangwuta mi ɛsɛ na.>>
Ta ongyesɔ ongwu ababɔ kɛ ka kye uga mgban yangwuta mi ɛsɛ, man indza okpɛkpɛ yi owulewo gbɔfwɛ tɔ mbi inggisɛ ama ndzɛ yi ambɛ mgbi mmbwaba di li sunu adagyɛ mgban mani.
Ongyesɔ ongwu fan kye uga mgban yangwuta mi onekyoo, man i kyata yɛɛ dafi eyi mgbi inggisɛ ikwukwɔ mani, ta ungwɔ oshishe ama nwoto onekyoo duu kwulu.
Ongyesɔ ongwu ta kye uga mgban yangwuta mi ekyoo bɛyi ibu, man a yɛɛ eyi.
Nɛ ani fwo ongyesɔ ongwu nle di mi eni ma gbɛɛ:

content.text: abu ndzɛ onɛnɛ di teyi dzɛ,
lubana a dzɛ eyi mgbi emi osaan
abu di kye eyi nu ma wa dafi

content: Man ani fwo ela nu uka mi iwashi gbɛɛ:

content.text: ikwɔ mgbi abu li oyɛyɛ di li otsitsi.>>

content: Ongyesɔ ongwu nɛ kye uga mgban yangwuta kyikɛ onɔ, man a nu onɔ mfye odzɛ inggisɛ ola yi otsɛɛtsɛ mgban nani.
Olola nkwulewo na to ma ta a fya iyi Imgbasho ongwu nle di mi ikye isɔ ntonɛ nɛ ito, kpaa a fwa okyatitukwu di kyile iyi mgban desho.
Ongyesɔ ongwu da kye uga mgban yangwuta mi itsuutɔ mgbi mmbwaba nani, ta iifu byakpa kyi gbɛlu esutɔ mgban sɔ, man isɔ nu inggisɛ wita ole la ewoma aba mi idɛ
di fya Imgbasho ongwi esho ito mi ikye isɔ bɛyi indza mgbi ama nani, kpaa a fwa okyatitukwu mi ungwɔ ngwi ama pɛpɛ kyɔ mani.
Ongyesɔ ongwu gyin kye uga mgban yangwuta mi ekyoo ogbagbadzidzi iYufreti nani, man eni mgban si ngwɔ ikye omɛ ofɛ mi ikye utɔ ama nkyɛ mi onosa mani.
Nɛ ani di onodzi ibwubwe nghi eta nto dafi aliɔ mani; a tɔ mi ondu mgbi ozumenyi, tɔ mi ondu mgbi mmbwaba di tɔ mi ondu mgbi oyegbɔ atsika.
A li onodzi emɛsɛ tole kyɔ ambɛ okwulewo, a di li tasɛ kɛ mbi emi utɔ mi ɛsɛ duu, okwu ma kwakye mi ikye egbe ika okwulewo mgbi Imgbasho onghaangha nani.
Wɛ di iYesu gbɛɛ, <<Dii, ani ka ba dafi emumyi mani! Ikyese ka dzɛ yi inggisɛ nkwasisa di gbe angwuto mgban tokɛ biyan, ikye ni ongwu ka kyɛ ibiba di kye iba mgban dɛsɛ ba mani.>>
Nɛ onodzi ibwubwe ntona kwu utɔ kwakye mi imbe ngwi a li kwun mi ondu iHibru gbɛɛ Amagidɔn nani.
Ongyesɔ ongwu gyafa ma kye uga mgban yangwuta mi awo, man ela okwukwo tɔ mi ozu okwukwo osunu Imgbasho mi itsuutɔ, le gbɛɛ, <<I ngyɛ wa!>>
Man mmbwo naabɔ, gbaadu, akpala gbo ɛsɛ di suusu kpakpa. Ɛsɛ osuusu onyi kpaa gyɔ yi ongwunɛ waba wita mi onɔ ngwi a ta inggisɛ nghataa ba onɛnɛni, Ɛsɛ osuusu nɛ timbi ngha duu.
Ogalu okwukwo na gha ayɛ eta, ta ogalu mi ɛsɛ duu gbobu. Imgbasho wɛ Angbodzi iBabyilon man kye ibwɛ eneekwɔ itingga mgbi ongwu kye nun.
Ali ibu duu tsebyulu, unggwɔ kpaa a di ma wuba.
Akwutsɛ mmbwo nshe ngwi undo ma mɛ ideli onyi kyɛ esho wa le gyɛ inggisɛ. Man a nya Imgbasho agya mi ikye isɔ mmbwo akwutsɛ nani, ikyekyɛ isɔ na kwulewo kwuba.
